question:
Some conditional data is provided to you in form of statement you have to check which of the following statement are logically inference from given statement.

Statement: Every house on Maple Street has a red roof. The house at 123 Oak Street has a blue roof.

What can we infer?

options.text: 123 Oak Street is not on Maple Street
Oak Street is different from Maple Street

Every house on Maple Street has a red roof.

The house at 123 Oak Street has a blue roof.
